title: CISA-AA23-347A-Ransomware-Response
summary: Joint cybersecurity advisory on immediate containment, eradication, and recovery procedures for ransomware infections.
content:
1. Immediate Actions Following Ransomware Detection

1.1 Endpoint Isolation: Immediately isolate affected devices from the local area network, Wi-Fi, and storage networks to halt lateral encryption propagation. Disable unauthenticated network sharing and disable SMB protocols on edge switches.

1.2 Power Down Offline Backup Repositories: Disconnect and power down secondary backup stores that have not yet exhibited encryption indicators. Verify air-gapped snapshots before adversary operators locate storage credentials.

2. Forensic Triage & Investigation

2.1 Identify Initial Foothold: Review perimeter VPN logs, external RDP access events, and email gateway attachment execution timestamps to identify the patient zero host.

2.2 Command Line Auditing: Inspect PowerShell and CMD logs for volume shadow copy deletion commands: vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet and bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No.

3. Recovery Procedures

3.1 Clean System Restoration: Re-image compromised endpoints from known-clean golden images before restoring business data from immutable backups. Never restore from backups made after the confirmed dwell time window without thorough offline AV scanning.

steps.title: Physically isolate infected hosts from LAN and SAN
steps.description: Disconnect network cables and disable wireless interfaces immediately on hosts exhibiting ransomware or mass file renaming activity to stop lateral spread.

steps.title: Secure and air-gap backup storage
steps.description: Sever network connections to online backup repositories and immutable storage pools immediately to prevent encryption or wiper activity targeting recovery points.

steps.title: Audit shadow copy deletion and recovery tampering commands
steps.description: Inspect process execution telemetry for vssadmin.exe, wmic shadowcopy delete, and bcdedit commands used to inhibit system recovery.

steps.title: Rebuild endpoints and restore from verified offline backups
steps.description: Re-image infected machines from known-clean images and restore data only from immutable, verified clean backups taken prior to adversary dwell time.
